title: fix(plugin-form): take the inline grid's line-position field from the spec helper
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xWfytqkQmEdCGXYLMHPN41D)_
Fixes #32283

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:主从表单内联网格的「行序字段」(拖拽排序时写入、读取明细行时按它排序)改由 spec 的 `deriveInlineGridSortField` 判定,渲染器里那份自己抄的字段名单删掉了。
- 为什么改:两份名单此前靠人工保持一致,没有任何东西钉住它们相等;今后 spec 改名单,网格自动跟上,lint 规则 `field-no-consumers` 认的字段与网格读的字段也是同一个。
- 风险与回滚:行为不变(两份名单在 `main` 上同为六个名字、同序);首屏体积不增(`vendor-objectstack` +0 B)。回滚即还原 `deriveMasterDetail.ts` 一个文件。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts`(`deriveDetail` 里 `sortField` 那一行),再看两份测试新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.test.ts packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.storedLineOrder-12286.test.tsx`,预期全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,等席位评审后由席位落地。

## What changes

`deriveDetail` (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts`) now takes the inline grid's line-position field from `deriveInlineGridSortField` in `@objectstack/spec/data` (published by #32276), and the local `SORT_FIELD_NAMES` literal is deleted. The helper reads `def.fields`; `deriveDetail` already holds the child as `childSchema: { fields? } | undefined`, so it is passed as is (the helper answers `undefined` for a missing definition or field map, as the local code did). `MasterDetailForm.tsx` is untouched: it still hands `sortField` to the grid on the authored-columns and derived branches and builds the lines read's `$orderby` from it.

## Why

The spec's private `INLINE_GRID_SORT_FIELDS` and the renderer's copy were equal only by hand. The lint rule `field-no-consumers` credits the line-position field through the helper, so a drift between the two would have credited one field while the grid read another.

Premise on `origin/main` `ac9622e3` (read before editing): the helper is exported from `@objectstack/spec/data`; the spec list is `position`, `sort_order`, `sequence`, `line_no`, `line_number`, `sort`, and the renderer list was the same six names in the same order, with the same first-match-in-field-order rule. So the change keeps behaviour.

## Tests

- `deriveMasterDetail.test.ts`, new describe "deriveDetail takes the line-position field from the spec": for each of the six names, a child whose only sort-named field is that name (behind five number decoys `order`, `seq`, `rank`, `line`, `sort_index`) gets it as `sortField`, the same answer as `deriveInlineGridSortField`; a child with only the decoys gets no `sortField` from either; the first sort-named field in field order wins.
- `MasterDetailForm.storedLineOrder-12286.test.tsx`, new describe in the existing harness (its `renderForm` now takes the child schema, defaulting to the old one): a child whose sort-named field is `line_no` opens its lines in stored order and the lines read carries `$orderby` `line_no` asc then `id` asc; a child with no sort-named field (decoys `order`, `seq`) draws the server's order and no read of its lines carries `$orderby`.

Ablation (committed fix first, mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each leg restored to `git diff HEAD` empty):
- local list without `line_number`: 1 failed (the `line_number` row), 54 passed.
- local list with `order` added: 8 failed (all six name rows, since the decoy `order` now wins; the decoys row; the form-level no-sort pin, whose read now orders by `order`), 47 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- `check:eager-closure`: console built twice under the verify lock (branch, then the same tree with `deriveMasterDetail.ts` restored from `ac9622e3`), `eager-closure.json` compared by chunk name. `vendor-objectstack` 627,144 → 627,144 gz bytes (+0): the file already imported runtime values from `@objectstack/spec/data`, and the helper lives in the module already in that chunk. `plugin-form` 43,770 → 43,728 (−42); ten other eager chunks moved +1 to +8 bytes (hashed chunk names they reference); eager closure total −11 bytes gz. The gate passes on the branch build.
- Sibling #31912 may also edit `deriveMasterDetail.ts`; this diff touches only the import line, the deleted constant and the `sortField` line.

## Verification

- Focused files before the merge, at `cfad6ef2` (`deriveMasterDetail.test.ts`, `MasterDetailForm.storedLineOrder-12286.test.tsx`, `MasterDetailForm.inlineColumnsSortAmount-11144.test.tsx`): 3 files, 58 tests passed. The package run below covers them again on the merged head.
